goal: Normalize Qwen, Grok, and DeepSeek behind independent credential-safe connectors, then decouple connection readiness from Provider selection and downstream code growth.
acceptance_criteria: all candidates run the same prompt facts, schema, limits, retry policy, workspace, and acceptance
profiles are task-specific and require two independent cases
schema, scope, interface, and secret-safety failures make a profile ineligible
selection is reliability-first and deterministic, with unknown cost excluded rather than treated as zero
routing is frozen before a run and fallback remains deny
each vendor has an independent connector, connection profile, request translation, probe sequence, and error classifier
all connectors satisfy one canonical structured completion contract with local Draft 2020-12 validation
connection readiness is recorded independently from quality selection and downstream builder readiness

quality_metrics.target: one isolated connector per registered Provider and zero vendor branching in the registry or GatewayCompletionClient
zero credential material in receipts, logs, snapshots, exceptions, or Git
all connector success paths pass the same Draft 2020-12 validator
connection, selection, codegen, builder, and growth states cannot imply each other

accepted: bounded Provider evaluation contracts, suite, receipts, profiles, cache, selector, and routing snapshot
Micro, Fast, and Promotion regression evidence
blocked: DeepSeek chat models reject json_schema response_format
zero eligible Providers; minimum is two

routing_policy: fallback deny; no provider change within a run
